summary: Teaches enabling Agent Observability, creating an access policy token, instrumenting an agent with the SDK, and viewing generations, traces and metrics.

needs.description: Agent Observability app (/a/grafana-agento11y-app) available; milestone 1 enables it (not yet enabled state is assumed).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "Agent Observability is not yet enabled; Milestone 1 enables it"

needs.description: Admin role on the stack; ability to create access policies and tokens in Cloud portal (/a/grafana-auth-app).
Local agent in Go/Python/JS/Java/.NET with language runtime (Python 3.10+, Node 22+, Go 1.23+, Java 17+, .NET 8+) running the SDK sample to send a generation.
LLM provider API key for own agent/.NET helper (first manual sample does not need one).
Traces Drilldown (grafana-exploretraces-app) and Metrics Drilldown (grafana-metricsdrilldown-app) plus traces/metrics data from the agent.
At least one captured generation in Conversations in the time range (produced by running the SDK sample).

reviewNotes: Path expects a clean state (feature not enabled, token shown once); on a pre-seeded stack the enable step may already be done. Data comes from a learner-run SDK process.
